problem: Every site I build with AI ends up with the same rounded cards, soft grey shadows and all-caps labels, and clients can tell right away.
solution: One command installs Anthropic's frontend-design skill in Claude Code. Claude then plans palette, type and layout, checks it for defaults, then codes.
share_identity: if you ship landing pages or client sites built with Claude Code
takeaway: Anthropic's skill lists AI tells to cut: identical rounded cards with rgba(0,0,0,.1) shadows, all-caps labels, and a → on button text.
deliverable: A one-page PDF checklist of the AI design tells named in the current SKILL.md, plus the exact install command for a Claude Code session and for the shell.
one_true_thing: One command, /plugin install frontend-design@claude-plugins-official, and the skill switches on by itself for frontend work. Its SKILL.md even flags Anthropic's own #D97757 terracotta as an AI tell.
